cat > /workspace/tests/test_misc.py << 'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import *

def doc(cases, events, channels, definitions=None, timeout_ms=5, seed='seed1'):
    return {'seed': seed, 'definitions': definitions or [], 'timeout_ms': timeout_ms,
            'cases': cases, 'events': events, 'channels': channels}

def case(name, frames, method='GET', target='/a', host='h'):
    return {'name': name, 'frames': frames,
            'expect': {'method': method, 'target': target, 'host': host}}

# ---- headers_kv preserves JSON member order in receipt and coordinates ----
kv = {'b': '<<random_string>>', 'a': '<<random_string>>'}
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [{'Type': 'headers', 'headers_kv': kv, 'End_Stream': True}])], []))
c = r['cases'][0]
h0 = rnd('seed1', 'case/0/frame/0/h/0/v', 0)
h1 = rnd('seed1', 'case/0/frame/0/h/1/v', 0)
sent = act(0, 0, 'H', [(b'b', h0.encode()), (b'a', h1.encode())], True)
check('kv order + coords', c['sent'] == fp(sent), c['sent'])
check('kv payload bytes', c['payload_bytes'] == 2 + 20 + 1 + 20)

# ---- header name coordinates ---------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [{'Type': 'headers', 'data_to_transfered': [['<<random_string>>', 'x']], 'End_Stream': True}])], []))
n0 = rnd('seed1', 'case/0/frame/0/h/0/n', 0)
sent = act(0, 0, 'H', [(n0.encode(), b'x')], True)
check('header name coordinate', r['cases'][0]['sent'] == fp(sent), r['cases'][0]['sent'])

# ---- per-template occurrence reset ---------------------------------------
frames = [{'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': '<<random_string>>'},
          {'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': '<<random_string>>', 'End_Stream': True}]
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', frames)], []))
sent = act(0, 0, 'D', rnd('seed1', 'case/0/frame/0/data', 0).encode(), False) + \
       act(0, 0, 'D', rnd('seed1', 'case/0/frame/1/data', 0).encode(), True)
check('occurrence resets per template', r['cases'][0]['sent'] == fp(sent), r['cases'][0]['sent'])

# ---- event coordinates ----------------------------------------------------
events = [
    {'at': 1, 'kind': 'headers', 'stream': 0, 'fields': [['<<random_string>>', '<<random_string>>']], 'end': False},
    {'at': 2, 'kind': 'data', 'stream': 0, 'data': '<<random_string>>', 'end': True},
]
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [{'Type': 'headers', 'headers_kv': {'a': 'b'}, 'End_Stream': True}])], events))
recv = act(1, 0, 'h', [(rnd('seed1', 'event/0/h/0/n', 0).encode(), rnd('seed1', 'event/0/h/0/v', 0).encode())], False) + \
       act(2, 0, 'd', rnd('seed1', 'event/1/data', 0).encode(), True)
check('event coordinates', r['cases'][0]['received'] == fp(recv), r['cases'][0]['received'])

# ---- channel part coordinate ---------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [{'Type': 'headers', 'headers_kv': {'a': 'b'}, 'End_Stream': True}])], [],
                [{'name': 'z', 'parts': [{'case': 'c', 'data': '<<random_string>>'}]}]))
part = rnd('seed1', 'channel/0/part/0/data', 0)
check('channel part coordinate', r['channels'][0]['bytes'] == fp(part.encode()), r['channels'][0]['bytes'])

# ---- datagram End_Stream is ignored --------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [
    {'Type': 'datagram', 'data_to_transfered': 'g', 'End_Stream': True},
    {'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': 'x', 'End_Stream': True}])], []))
c = r['cases'][0]
sent = act(0, 0, 'G', b'g', False) + act(0, 0, 'D', b'x', True)
check('datagram end ignored', c['state'] == 'timeout' and c['frames'] == 2 and c['sent'] == fp(sent), c['state'])

# ---- response end while paused then send error ---------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [
    {'Type': 'sleep', 'Time_to_Stop': 5},
    {'Type': 'headers', 'headers_kv': {'a': 'b'}, 'End_Stream': True},
    {'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': 'x'}])],
    [{'at': 1, 'kind': 'headers', 'stream': 0, 'fields': [['s', '2']], 'end': True}]))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('end then send_error', c['state'] == 'send_error' and c['at'] == 5 and c['response_frames'] == 1, c)

# ---- empty headers frame counts ------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [{'Type': 'headers', 'headers_kv': {}, 'End_Stream': True}])], []))
c = r['cases'][0]
sent = act(0, 0, 'H', [], True)
check('empty headers frame', c['frames'] == 1 and c['request_frames'] == 1 and c['sent'] == fp(sent), c)

# ---- data default End_Stream ---------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [{'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': 'x'},
                            {'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': 'y'}])], []))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('data default end', c['state'] == 'send_error' and c['frames'] == 1, c)

# ---- only sleeps cannot finish ------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [{'Type': 'sleep', 'Time_to_Stop': 3}])], []))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('sleep only timeout', c['state'] == 'timeout' and c['at'] == 8 and c['frames'] == 0, c)

# ---- definitions shared across places ------------------------------------
defs = [['pre', "b'X-'"], ['body', "pre + pre + b'z'"]]
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [{'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': '{{body}}', 'End_Stream': True}])],
                [{'at': 1, 'kind': 'data', 'stream': 0, 'data': '{{pre}}', 'end': True}],
                [{'name': 'z', 'parts': [{'case': 'c', 'data': '{{body}}'}]}], definitions=defs))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('def in data', c['sent'] == fp(act(0, 0, 'D', b'X-X-z', True)), c['sent'])
check('def in event', c['received'] == fp(act(1, 0, 'd', b'X-', True)), c['received'])
check('def in channel', r['channels'][0]['bytes'] == fp(b'X-X-z'))

# ---- slice offsets in bytes within multibyte char -------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [{'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': "{{ 'é'.encode('ascii') }}"[:0] or "{{ 'abé' }}", 'End_Stream': True}])], []))
# plain literal 'abé' -> utf-8 bytes ab + c3a9
check('utf8 literal', r['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'] == 4, r['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'])
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [{'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': "{{ 'abé'[0:3] }}", 'End_Stream': True}])], []))
# python str slice is by code point: 'abé' -> b'ab\xc3\xa9' ; [0:3] slices the BYTES -> 'ab\xc3'
check('byte slice within char', r['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'] == 3 and
      r['cases'][0]['sent'] == fp(act(0, 0, 'D', 'abé'.encode()[:3], True)), r['cases'][0]['sent'])

# ---- events for later streams after close across cases --------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('a', [{'Type': 'headers', 'headers_kv': {'a': 'b'}, 'End_Stream': True}]),
                 case('b', [{'Type': 'sleep', 'Time_to_Stop': 9}, {'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': 'x'}])],
                [{'at': 2, 'kind': 'close'},
                 {'at': 2, 'kind': 'data', 'stream': 4, 'data': 'z', 'end': True}]))
check('close+event tie input order 1', r['cases'][1]['state'] == 'closed' and r['cases'][1]['response_frames'] == 0)
r = run_obj(doc([case('a', [{'Type': 'headers', 'headers_kv': {'a': 'b'}, 'End_Stream': True}]),
                 case('b', [{'Type': 'sleep', 'Time_to_Stop': 9}, {'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': 'x'}])],
                [{'at': 2, 'kind': 'data', 'stream': 4, 'data': 'z', 'end': True},
                 {'at': 2, 'kind': 'close'}]))
check('close+event tie input order 2', r['cases'][1]['state'] == 'closed' and r['cases'][1]['response_frames'] == 1)

summary()
EOF
cd /workspace && python3 tests/test_misc.py
